{{< video videos/benchmark.mp4 >}}

Copies of ubiquitin on a grid, one full turn each, timed end to end and written to
     `benchmark.json`. Not a claim about peak performance; a reproducible number for one
     machine.

After ProteinMotion's [`benchmark.py`](https://github.com/pdpppd/proteinmotion/blob/main/examples/benchmark.py).

## Script

Run it with `uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/benchmark.py out_dir`; set
`MN_EXAMPLES_QUICK=1` for a small, fast check. The script is included from the file:

```{.python filename="scripts/benchmark.py"}
{{< include scripts/benchmark.py >}}
```
